"""Read exact HEPLCP04 local-choice receipts without granting use authority.

The default profile preserves qualified Evaluation and UpdateCandidates when
local policy keeps the parent. An explicit native-use mode also joins the
original bounded export and its ACK. Public readback is not signature or
current-use authorization, and a same-actor new run is not independent C.
"""

def review_native_local_decision_use(
        selection_raw, completed_raw, root_profile_raw, readback_raw, *,
        expected_selection_sha256, expected_completed_sha256, expected_root_profile_sha256,
        expected_readback_sha256, frozen, expected):
    """Join an exact v4 continuation to an original acknowledged native use.

    Local defer/retain keeps the qualified parent descriptor; it is not an
    Evaluation or Proposal NoUpdate. The original native reader remains the
    gate for publication, grant bindings, manifest, intent, journal and ACK.
    Neither reader authenticates those public bytes or grants current use.
    """
    prior = review_native_local_decision(
        selection_raw, completed_raw, root_profile_raw,
        expected_selection_sha256=expected_selection_sha256,
        expected_completed_sha256=expected_completed_sha256,
        expected_root_profile_sha256=expected_root_profile_sha256, frozen=frozen)
    original = native.review_native_learning_use(
        readback_raw, expected_readback_sha256=expected_readback_sha256, expected=expected)
    native.require(not original["pending_work"] and not original["pending_delivery"],
                   "LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_ACK_PENDING")

    selection, replay = decode_native_local_checkpoint(selection_raw)
    request = selection["request"]
    envelope = native.decode(readback_raw, native.MAX_WIRE)
    _, payload = native.raw_json(envelope["payload_json"])
    retained = prior["retained_model"]
    native.require((payload["disposition"] == "retained_model") == retained,
                   "LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_DISPOSITION")
    selected = selection["receipts"][-1]
    native.require(replay["head"] == native.native_digest(payload["learning_head"]) and
                   selected["predecessor"] == native.native_digest(payload["learning_decision_head"]),
                   "LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_HEAD")
    native.require(
        request["operation_id"] == payload["learning_operation_id"] and
        request["source_run_id"] == payload["source_run_id"] and
        request["completed_task_receipt"] == native.native_digest(payload["source_task_receipt"]) and
        request["selected_artifact_digest"] == native.native_digest(payload["source_selected_artifact"]) and
        legacy.bundle_digest(request["selected_bundle"]) == native.native_digest(payload["source_selected_bundle"]),
        "LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_SOURCE")

    _, publication = native.raw_json(payload["publication_json"])
    scope = publication["intent"]["target"]["scope"]
    native.require(request["principal_id"] == native.native_digest(scope["principal_digest"]) and
                   request["agent_id"] == scope["agent_id"] and request["cell_id"] == scope["cell_id"],
                   "LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_SCOPE")
    use = payload["observation"]
    native.require(
        selected["observation"]["selection_digest"] == native.native_digest(use["selection_digest"]) and
        prior["selected_bundle_digest"] == native.native_digest(use["bundle_digest"]) ==
        original["bundle_digest"] == legacy.bundle_digest(prior["complete_version_descriptor"]),
        "LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_SELECTION")

    observed = dict(tag=7 if retained else 6, state_partition=dict(
        principal_id=native.native_digest(scope["principal_digest"]),
        agent_id=scope["agent_id"], cell_id=scope["cell_id"], run_id=scope["run_id"]))
    observed["retained_bundle" if retained else "candidate_bundle"] = native.native_digest(use["bundle_digest"])
    for name in ("checkpoint_digest", "selection_digest", "committed_step_receipt",
                 "task_owner_publication" if retained else "state_cutover_receipt"):
        observed[name] = native.native_digest(use[name])
    native.require(prior["final_observation"] == observed, "LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_NEXT_USE")

    result = dict(prior)
    result.update(
        schema=NATIVE_USE_REPORT_SCHEMA,
        scope="pinned-heplcp04-root-scope-and-original-acknowledged-native-use-only",
        native_readback_sha256=expected_readback_sha256,
        native_readback_review=original,
        selection_to_native_use_bindings_consistent=True,
        final_next_use_matches_original_actor=True,
        acknowledged_use_observed=True,
        model_stop_observed=original["model_stop_observed"],
        terminal_episode_observed=original["terminal_episode_observed"])
    return result

from test_cell_adoption_readback import encode_payload
from test_cell_learning_iteration_join import MutationWriter

def native_case(self, phase):
        """Load unchanged historical exports only as unrelated rejection inputs."""
        directory = ROOT / "evidence/cell-adoption-20261108/native-readbacks"
        manifest_raw = (directory / "fixture-manifest.json").read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(native.sha(manifest_raw), NATIVE_USE_MANIFEST_SHA256)
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_raw)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["scope"], "original-native-engineering-fixtures-not-production")
        entry = manifest["exports"][phase]
        raw = (directory / entry["file"]).read_bytes()
        expected_raw = (directory / (phase + ".expected.json")).read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual((len(raw), native.sha(raw)), (entry["bytes"], entry["sha256"]))
        self.assertEqual((len(expected_raw), native.sha(expected_raw)),
                         (entry["fixture_expected_bytes"], entry["fixture_expected_sha256"]))
        return raw, expected_raw

    def review_native_use(self, index, raw, expected_raw, **pins):
        selection, completed, profile, frozen = self.inputs(index)
        return local.review_native_local_decision_use(
            selection, completed, profile, raw,
            expected_selection_sha256=native.sha(selection),
            expected_completed_sha256=native.sha(completed),
            expected_root_profile_sha256=native.sha(profile),
            expected_readback_sha256=pins.get("readback", native.sha(raw)),
            frozen=frozen, expected=json.loads(expected_raw))

    def test_native_use_requires_the_original_export_byte_pin(self):
        raw, expected = self.native_case("retained_acked")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "NATIVE_READBACK_PIN"):
            self.review_native_use(1, raw, expected, readback="00" * 32)

    def test_actual_pending_native_exports_cannot_ack_any_local_choice(self):
        for index, phase in ((0, "adopted_pending"), (1, "retained_pending"), (2, "retained_pending")):
            raw, expected = self.native_case(phase)
            with self.subTest(index=index), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_ACK_PENDING"):
                self.review_native_use(index, raw, expected)

    def test_actual_acked_old_iteration_exports_cannot_join_v4_heads(self):
        # These are real old native export bytes, not synthesized v4 evidence.
        # Their independent native review cannot attach them to a new tag-9 cut.
        for index, phase in ((0, "adopted_acked"), (1, "retained_acked"), (2, "retained_acked")):
            raw, expected = self.native_case(phase)
            with self.subTest(index=index), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_HEAD"):
                self.review_native_use(index, raw, expected)

    def test_native_disposition_cannot_override_defer_retain_or_adopt(self):
        for index, phase in ((0, "retained_acked"), (1, "adopted_acked"), (2, "adopted_acked")):
            raw, expected = self.native_case(phase)
            with self.subTest(index=index), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_DISPOSITION"):
                self.review_native_use(index, raw, expected)

    def test_native_use_keeps_the_original_deny_all_guard(self):
        raw, expected = self.native_case("retained_acked")
        payload = json.loads(json.loads(raw)["payload_json"])
        for field, value in (("authority", "ALLOW"), ("current_permission", "EXPORTED")):
            altered = copy.deepcopy(payload)
            altered[field] = value
            # A hostile rehash reaches the original authority guard; it does
            # not manufacture a successful export, grant or completion proof.
            with self.subTest(field=field), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "NATIVE_AUTHORITY_ESCALATION"):
                self.review_native_use(1, encode_payload(altered), expected)

    def test_native_cli_refuses_every_partial_optional_input_group(self):
        selection, completed, profile, frozen = self.inputs(1)
        raw, expected = self.native_case("retained_acked")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            files = {"selection-checkpoint": selection, "completed-checkpoint": completed,
                     "root-profile": profile, "freeze": wire(frozen), "readback": raw, "expected": expected}
            command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(ROOT / "scripts/cell_learning_local_decision_join.py")]
            for name, data in files.items():
                (Path(directory) / name).write_bytes(data)
                if name not in ("readback", "expected"):
                    command.extend(("--" + name, str(Path(directory) / name),
                                    "--" + name + "-sha256", native.sha(data)))
            optional = [("--readback", str(Path(directory) / "readback")),
                        ("--readback-sha256", native.sha(raw)),
                        ("--expected", str(Path(directory) / "expected")),
                        ("--expected-sha256", native.sha(expected))]
            for missing in range(len(optional)):
                arguments = [value for index, pair in enumerate(optional) if index != missing for value in pair]
                refused = subprocess.run(command + arguments, capture_output=True, timeout=15)
                with self.subTest(missing=missing):
                    self.assertNotEqual(refused.returncode, 0)
                    self.assertIn(b"LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_ARGUMENTS", refused.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(sorted(path.name for path in Path(directory).iterdir()), sorted(files))

    def test_native_cli_calls_the_exact_join_and_checks_expectation_bytes(self):
        selection, completed, profile, frozen = self.inputs(1)
        raw, expected = self.native_case("retained_acked")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            files = {"selection-checkpoint": selection, "completed-checkpoint": completed,
                     "root-profile": profile, "freeze": wire(frozen), "readback": raw, "expected": expected}
            command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(ROOT / "scripts/cell_learning_local_decision_join.py")]
            for name, data in files.items():
                path = Path(directory) / name
                path.write_bytes(data)
                command.extend(("--" + name, str(path), "--" + name + "-sha256", native.sha(data)))
            refused = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=15)
            self.assertNotEqual(refused.returncode, 0)
            self.assertIn(b"LOCAL_DECISION_NATIVE_HEAD", refused.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(refused.stdout, b"")
            bad_pin = list(command)
            bad_pin[bad_pin.index("--expected-sha256") + 1] = "00" * 32
            refused = subprocess.run(bad_pin, capture_output=True, timeout=15)
            self.assertNotEqual(refused.returncode, 0)
            self.assertIn(b"EXPECTATIONS_PIN", refused.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(sorted(path.name for path in Path(directory).iterdir()), sorted(files))

The default four-input profile does not consume a native-use export. It retains
its original schema and acknowledged_use_observed=false. The separate explicit

A same-actor different-run observation does not establish independent C.

## Explicit native-use join

Supplying both --readback and --expected, each with its -sha256 pin, selects
trnm-cell-learning-local-decision-native-use-readback-v1. Every one of these
four optional arguments must be present together. A partial group is refused;
omitting all four preserves the original structural profile.

The CLI calls review_native_local_decision_use. That function first calls the
unchanged review_native_local_decision and then the unchanged original
cell_adoption_readback.review_native_learning_use. The second reader validates
the exact native export envelope, payload commitment, complete manifest,
original publication and public grant bindings, intent, committed step,
journal observation and expected inputs. This proposal does not alter that
reader or the existing HEPLCP02 completion/scope readers.

The additional join requires all of the following:

1. No native pending work or pending delivery. Model STOP and a terminal
   episode remain separately reported; an ACK is not either fact.
2. Native retained/adopted disposition agrees with the actual tag-9 choice.
   DeferCandidate and RetainParent use the complete parent descriptor while
   no_update remains false; AdoptCandidate uses the trained candidate.
3. The native learning head equals the exact Selection-cut head. Its decision
   head equals that Selection receipt's predecessor, including LocalDecisionV2.
4. Original learning operation, source run, completed task receipt, selected
   artifact and complete parent bundle match the frozen request.
5. The publication target has the same original principal, agent and Cell.
   Its new run and every final use field must match the completed observation.
6. The Selection digest and selected bundle match the native observation,
   native manifest and complete selected version descriptor.
7. The sole appended NextUse or RetainedModelNextUse observation equals the
   original native checkpoint, committed step and cutover/publication values.

Only then does the new report set acknowledged_use_observed=true. That flag
describes the consistency of the supplied original bytes. It does not
authenticate their custody, signatures, freshness or external producer.
All authority and business-qualification refusals from the structural report
remain intact, including independent_consumer_verified=false,
hepta_final_use_accepted=false and production_activation=false.

### Actual native producer contract

The relevant original Hepta source was read at
cbf6ca7dd619589be3e9e98755f185d34d0f7413. The paths below are under
codex-rs/hepta-agentd/src:

| Source | Git blob | Exact responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| neuron_generation_learning_runtime.rs | de50528a4245324360b465cc93bc25519255f2ea | The existing bounded actor exposes read_learning_next_use_readback and read_learning_updated_next_use_readback. |
| neuron_generation_learning_readback.rs | 3a8d21d2c5d10154f746ae781dacffaa6de23a36 | export_next_use derives use from the actual held journal/publication, captures the Selection head/predecessor, and retains DENY_ALL/NOT_EXPORTED. |
| neuron_generation_update_learning.rs | 88c5ec9658ef561af3658f5a73f8bfa7f89d9243 | The retained path requires the actual next-task bundle to equal the complete original parent, exact original owner progression and OwnerDrainedSameModel. |
| neuron_generation_update_adopted_learning.rs | 6ed28321bbc1b51b442445b70ff4794b88d1af50 | The adopted path requires the qualified selected candidate, actual model-reset publication and both complete manifest contracts. |

Those are real export APIs, not a new authority issuer or evidence that an
ordinary deployment has invoked them. The local CLI is an explicit read-only
consumer. This change does not install an ordinary runtime caller, obtain
signed tag-9/Selection/NextUse attestations, issue a grant, or prove an
independent consumer adopted a published artifact.

The existing HEPLCP04 corpus contains synthetic policy/Selection/NextUse
observations emitted through the original codec/coordinator. The existing
native-use corpus is a separate historical engineering run. They cannot be
joined into a positive record by relabeling or rehashing. Seven added controls
use unchanged historical exports as refusal inputs: wrong pins, pending ACK,
cross-iteration heads, incompatible disposition, attempted authority
escalation, partial CLI arguments and exact CLI expectation/join refusal.
No successful HEPLCP04/native-use pair is manufactured by the tests.

A later qualification run must capture the actual v4 Selection cut, the original
native export while that coordinator awaits NextUse, and the single completed
continuation, together with independently supplied original freeze, Root scope
and native expectations. This proposal supplies no such new execution record.
The ordinary_complete_chain / positive_adoption_chain /
no_update_or_rollback_chain acceptance counts remain 0 / 0 / 0. Independent C
and actual daemon plus Root OS restart remain unaccepted.
